en.t: Could it be... just his imagination...

units.source_text: 总而言之，眼神那玩意儿不过是语言的表达……

en.t: In any case, a look in the eyes was nothing more than an expression of language...

units.source_text: 没有肌肉的眼珠里，怎么可能还积存着表情。

en.t: How could an eyeball with no muscles still hold any expression?

units.source_text: 这样想着，男人往后退缩了几步，

en.t: Thinking this, the man shrank back a few steps,

units.source_text: 想去放松一下塞在她嘴里的东西，禁不住伸过手去。

en.t: and, wanting to loosen whatever was stuffed in her mouth, he could not help reaching out his hand.
